setup.notAPayload: this file does not contain KyberNow. Download the full installer again.
setup.webview2Missing:
The installer needs Microsoft Edge WebView2, included in Windows 11 and most Windows 10 installations.

Microsoft's download page will open: install it, then run KyberNow-Server-Setup again.

uninstall.title: Uninstall KyberNow
uninstall.confirm:
KyberNow will be removed from this computer: streaming server, administration console, tray icon, virtual display. The power mode and network category from before KyberNow are restored.

The ViGEmBus gamepad driver stays installed, as other software may use it.

Continue?
uninstall.keepData:
Keep KyberNow's settings on this computer?

Yes: C:\ProgramData\KyberNow stays (console settings and certificate, known devices, logs, a copy of Kyber's settings), readable by administrators only.
No: everything is deleted.
uninstall.doneKept: KyberNow has been uninstalled. Its settings remain in C:\ProgramData\KyberNow.

gpu.title: Graphics card
gpu.noneDetail: Encoding will be done by the processor (x264): slower and more demanding.

driver.title: Graphics driver
driver.unknown: Unknown version: consider updating the graphics card driver.
driver.none: No graphics card driver: install the manufacturer's (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel) to get hardware encoding.

network.title: Local network
network.wifi: Wi-Fi · {ip} · an Ethernet cable avoids micro-dropouts
network.public: · network set to “Public”: we will switch it to “Private” so your devices can connect

ports.title: Network ports
ports.defaultBusy: The usual port 8080 is already in use{by}.
ports.picked: {reason}Drawn at random and checked free: stream {stream} · console {console}

display.title: Main display
display.none: No display detected: plug in a display or turn on the virtual display.

power.title: Power mode
power.tuned: The GPU keeps its full power during the stream.
power.notTuned: The GPU slows down to save energy, which can triple the encoding time. We will offer to change it at the Options step.

audio.title: Remote sound
audio.ok: Steam's virtual speakers are available: during the stream, the computer goes silent and the sound goes out in stereo, 5.1 or 7.1.
audio.missing: Steam is not installed: sound will also come out of the computer's speakers, in Windows' format. Install Steam, then run the installation again to get it.

existing.title: Existing installation
existing.keepChoice: At the next step, you will choose to keep your settings and devices, or to start from scratch.
existing.noSettings: Its settings cannot be found: the installation will start from scratch.
existing.kyberDetail: It will be removed and replaced by KyberNow's (same engine, tuned for you).

ports.samePort: The stream and the console need two different ports.
ports.reservedBy: Port {port} is in {owner}'s range ({first}–{last}), which that software often takes: choose another one.

install.settingsMissing: settings not found ({path}): choose “Start from scratch”
